description: Defines a class NatsBatchContainer implementing IBatchContainer for batching stream events in Orleans using NATS.

classes.name: NatsBatchContainer
classes.description: A batch container class for NATS stream events, implementing IBatchContainer, containing stream id, sequence token, events, request context, and reply information.

methods.name: GetEvents
methods.description: Retrieves events of a specific type along with their sequence token.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Overrides ToString to provide a summary of the batch container.
